title: Ad Creative Design in Charleston, SC
metaTitle: Ad Creative Design in Charleston, SC | TDM
metaDescription: Static, carousel and motion ad creatives for Charleston businesses on Meta, TikTok and Google, designed in test batches for visitors and for residents.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) designs ad creatives for Charleston businesses: the static images, carousels, banners and short motion pieces that run in paid campaigns on Meta, TikTok and Google. We design them in batches built for testing, export them for every placement, and replace them when results show they are wearing out. In Charleston the main creative question is who the ad is for, because a visitor planning a trip and a resident of Summerville need to see entirely different things.

sections.heading: The postcard problem
paragraphs: Every Charleston advertiser has access to the same pictures: pastel houses, church steeples, the Ravenel Bridge at dusk, a plate of shrimp and grits. Feeds aimed at people planning a visit are full of them, and they blur together. A hotel, tour or restaurant ad has to show what is particular to that business, such as the specific courtyard, the specific boat or the specific dish, with a clear reason to book directly.

For residents the postcard works even less. Someone who lives in West Ashley or Goose Creek does not need to be sold on Charleston. An ad for a dentist, a roofer, a gym or a private school should name the neighbourhood, show a recognisable local setting, and make one plain offer.

sections.heading: What the design work includes
paragraphs: Each batch explores several distinct angles, so a test compares ideas and not just colors.
bullets: Single-image ads that carry one idea and an offer readable at a glance.
Carousels that walk through rooms, menu items, services or a product range.
Animated statics and short motion graphics that need no filming.
Branded frames for catalog ads from online stores.
Every design resized for feed, story, reel and display placements, with text kept inside safe zones.
Refresh batches when frequency rises and response falls.

sections.heading: Designing for Charleston's calendar
paragraphs: Demand here moves in waves, and creative should be ready before each one. Spring and autumn trips are planned weeks or months earlier, so visitor ads need to be live during that planning period. Festival weeks, the bridge run and college graduation weekends fill hotels and restaurants and reward advertisers who prepared specific creative.

Local services follow a different rhythm. Roofers, tree services and restoration firms see searches jump after a storm, and it is better to have calm, practical ads approved in advance than to design them in a hurry. The weeks before the holidays matter most to King Street shops and the brands that ship gifts nationwide.

sections.heading: What we need from you
paragraphs: Good creative starts with real material. Send your own photographs and video, your logo files and brand colors, and the offers you can stand behind. Healthcare, housing and employment ads face extra platform rules on wording and targeting, so raise those categories at the start.

presence: A member of our team is based in South Carolina, not in Charleston itself. Ad creatives are designed remotely by TDM's design team and shared online for review, so the work proceeds the same way whether your business is on the peninsula or in Summerville.

faqs.q: Can you design ads for a Charleston business that runs its own campaigns?
faqs.a: Yes. We can supply creative batches for your team or another agency to run. If TDM manages the campaigns as well, the designers see the results directly and each new batch builds on what performed.

faqs.q: Should a Charleston business use different ads for tourists and locals?
faqs.a: Yes, in almost every case. Visitors respond to the specific experience and an easy way to book. Residents respond to a nearby location and a concrete offer. Mixing the two in one ad weakens both.

faqs.q: We have very few good photos. Can you still make ads?
faqs.a: Yes. Motion graphics, typographic designs and animated statics need no shoot. We will not use stock images of Charleston to stand in for your business.

faqs.q: How much do ad creatives cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of concepts, formats and sizes in each batch and how often batches are refreshed. The quote follows a free consultation.

faqs.q: How often should the creative be replaced?
faqs.a: When the numbers say so. Busy seasonal accounts tire faster than small steady ones. The refresh rhythm and delivery dates are agreed in the plan and adjusted to what the campaigns show.
